These stages are mapped into GSE modules where data is ingested via free-spine adapters, algorithms are trained offline with Elo/Poisson models, serving uses a query API that gates signals until GREEN, and evaluation employs Spearman rank correlation and holdout significance. The separation between training and serving ensures robustness against overfitting and enables controlled deployment. The system avoids real-time dual-stack operations, relying instead on documented offline processes. This design supports a principled approach to probabilistic forecasting in sports intelligence, where each stage contributes to a coherent Bayesian inference pipeline.
